factor_trim: p > X^(1/4) and p <= sqrt((1+eta)X), with p<=q

coordinate.domain: 0 < xi <= 1 under the registered factor trim
coordinate.bin_edges: j/32 for j=0..32; left-closed/right-open except final bin includes xi=1

prime_generation: deterministic Eratosthenes/segmented Eratosthenes exact integer sieve; no probabilistic primality in reference counts

null_a.name: CONDITIONAL_MICROCELL_WHEEL_SHUFFLE
null_a.microcell_definition: For q>=2, k=floor(log2(q)), j=floor(1024*(q-2^k)/2^k). Cell=(k,j). Within each Cell and each q mod 210 residue, preserve the exact observed prime count and sample without replacement from integer positions in the same Cell and residue. Prime 2,3,5,7 may be fixed as exceptional wheel primes when they fall in the global q-universe.
null_a.cross_scale_coupling: one surrogate q-set per replicate is shared by all discovery scales and shell widths
null_a.interval_rule: for each p count surrogate q in (X/p,(1+eta)X/p] with q>=p

null_b.name: WHEEL_PRESERVING_CYCLIC_GAP_SURROGATE
null_b.band_definition: Let t=floor(q/210). For t>=1, k=floor(log2(t)), j=floor(64*(t-2^k)/2^k). A band is the union of complete 210-blocks sharing (k,j). q<210 is fixed. For each band choose one uniform cyclic translation by an integer number of 210-blocks and wrap within that band's complete block range.
invariants: exact prime count in every band
every translated point preserves q mod 210
within-band circular gap multiset is preserved
one translated q-set per replicate is shared by all discovery scales and shell widths
null_b.interval_rule: for each p count surrogate q in (X/p,(1+eta)X/p] with q>=p

statistics.cell_observation: O[X,eta,b]=number of semiprime factor pairs (p,q) in xi-bin b after trim and square exclusion
statistics.standardization: z=(O-mu_null)/sigma_null for each X,eta,b and each null family separately
statistics.cross_scale: C[eta,b]=(1/sqrt(5))*sum over discovery X of z[X,eta,b]
statistics.familywise: T=max over eta,b of abs(C[eta,b]); threshold=empirical 0.99 quantile of replicate T
statistics.candidate_freeze: choose only a cell clearing the 99% family-wise threshold under BOTH null families; tie-break by minimum of the two standardized margins, then smaller eta, then lower bin index
statistics.sign_rule: candidate sign is sign of the observed cross-scale C and must match at least 4 of 5 discovery scales

holdout_gate.success: same frozen sign on BOTH 3e8 and 1e9; each holdout exceeds the predeclared one-sided 0.99 null threshold under BOTH null families
holdout_gate.failure: failure of either holdout or either null returns SECOND_ORDER_DENSITY_ARTIFACT unless NULL_MODEL_MISSPECIFICATION is independently established

forbidden_before_candidate_freeze: enumerating semiprime shell counts at X=300000000
enumerating semiprime shell counts at X=1000000000
using either new holdout to choose a statistic, bin, sign, cell size, band size, or null family
